note: The six TransactWriteItems and TransactGetItems value-layer tests in tests/tier3/error-messages/valueLayers.test.ts: malformed numbers and duplicate set members. DynamoDB checks attribute values in one of two layers, and in each test a region answered every request in the same one. capture1113 sent each test's requests once to every region registry/regions.json lists, at a table that does not exist, because the check fires before the table is looked up; eu-west-2 was also sent them once more a few seconds earlier, and the Delete with a duplicate SS as its key was also sent to every region in two other rounds that evening, at about 19:08 and 19:49 UTC. Every answer was a 400 ValidationException. confirm1114 ran the six tests themselves, against a real table, in four regions. A verdict is P when every request in the test got the current layer's answer (the answer eu-west-2 gives), X when every one got the older layer's, and - when the region did not answer. No region gave a mix of the two in any test, and no region answered any request outside the two lists. me-south-1 answered nothing. ap-south-1 gave the older layer on 2026-11-13 and the current one on 2026-11-14.
